title: 'Unfair': Canada suspends US trade talks after Trump's 'deal moving along' remark
content: In response to unfair trade terms imposed by the United States, Canada has decided to suspend its trade negotiations. With significant tariffs on Canadian imports set to take effect at midnight, Prime Minister Carney announced that Canada will retaliate with equivalent tariffs. Negotiators are being recalled to Ottawa, reflecting the uncertainty in discussions as Canada now shifts its focus towards boosting domestic economic growth and seeking new international trade opportunities.

title: 1 fall, 3 deaths at Maharashtra hill: How teen's iPhone demand ended in tragedy
content: An eighteen-year-old died after jumping from a hill when his parents refused him a mobile phone. His parents also lost their lives while attempting to rescue him from the steep cliff. Rescuers and family members made frantic efforts for nearly three hours to save the teenager. The father moved towards his son in the final moments and both fell.

title: Co-host Netherlands wear blue on blue turf, India play in saffron in Hockey WC

title: Govt orders Google to shut down hundreds of Firebase accounts over scam misuse
content: Indian authorities ordered Google to close hundreds of Firebase accounts.  These accounts were exploited by criminals for banking scams and malware.  Officials found a pattern of impersonating major banks to defraud users.  The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued multiple notices for account removals.  This action is part of India's increased efforts against online financial fraud.

title: Apple layoffs hit employees across teams; company confirms job cuts
content: Apple has decided to streamline its operations, resulting in layoffs of over two hundred employees from the Siri and Vision Pro divisions. The adjustments within the Vision Pro team involve reductions in gaming and immersive video content production as Apple shifts focus. Meanwhile, the Siri AI architecture undergoes a major overhaul, necessitating new skill sets, reflecting the company's strategic pivot towards smart glasses over its current headset model.

title: Cash, gold & elderly victims: How Indian-origin man became 'money mule' in $7.5m US scam

The scheme targeted elderly victims and involved millions of dollars.  Investigators believe he collected cash and gold from nine victims.  Canadian authorities arrested him at Toronto Pearson International Airport.

title: Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn

This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history.

title: Headingley horror! Pakistan create unwanted Test record in crushing defeat
content: Pakistan achieved an unwanted Test record by losing their opening wicket for zero runs in both innings. This rare feat occurred for the seventh time in their Test match history. England's bowlers dominated the match, securing an innings victory inside three days. Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue were instrumental in Pakistan's batting collapses. The result gave England a lead in the ongoing three-match series.

title: Family sold 53,000-acre California island for $30m, stayed 25 more years
content: In 1986, the United States government acquired Santa Rosa Island for close to thirty million dollars. This pivotal purchase marked the end of longstanding private ranching and agricultural practices on the sprawling island. Following the removal of cattle in 1998 and the cessation of residency in 2011, efforts towards environmental restoration commenced. Today, the island stands as a protected national sanctuary and an important cultural landmark.

title: After 28 years, Tasmania declares invasive carp functionally eradicated
content: After a remarkable 28-year campaign, Tasmania's fisheries service has successfully eliminated invasive common carp from Lake Sorell and Lake Crescent. This effort has seen the removal of over 49,000 harmful fish, leading to clearer waters and the revival of native plant life in marsh areas. The resurgence of wild brown trout has also enhanced recreational fishing opportunities for anglers, proving that large lakes can recover from invasive species.

title: How a ChatGPT user ‘embarrassed’ 3M in court

The expert acknowledged using the AI for most of the report, which became part of court discovery. This case highlights how AI conversations can be revealed during legal proceedings.

title: 2 killed after small plane crashes in Croatia
content:
Rescue teams find two dead after small plane crashes near Croatia’s Zadar

Two people were found dead late Friday after a small plane flying from the Czech Republic crashed in the mountains of Paklenica National Park, about 60 kilometres northeast of the coastal city of Zadar, news agency AP reported citing Croatian authorities said. “The search for the missing ultralight plane was concluded around 10pm when members of the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service found the plane and two dead persons," Croatian police said in a statement. Authorities have not yet disclosed the nationalities of the two people on board. Police said the crash site would be secured for an on-site investigation early Saturday to determine the circumstances of the accident. The search operation began after air traffic control raised an alarm when the aircraft’s signal was lost at around 4pm local time. Rescue teams later located the wreckage in the mountainous area.

title: At least 2 killed, several injured in reactor blast at Telangana pharma unit
content:
Reactor blast at Telangana pharma unit

Two workers were killed and nine others injured after a reactor blast triggered a fire at a pharmaceutical unit in Telangana's Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district late Friday night, police said. The incident took place at a pharma company in Pochampally mandal while workers were changing shifts, according to police. "Two persons died. Nine people were injured, including two who suffered more than 50 per cent burns while seven sustained minor injuries", a police official told PTI. The injured workers were admitted to different hospitals for treatment, the official said. The blast triggered a fire at the unit, which was later brought under control by the Fire Department. Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.
